final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 with the requested 30 delegations, SOA, NS, glue, apex A and MX records.  
Configured pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) as the recursive resolver and pc33–pc40 as clients; `www.example.com` uses pc6’s existing address.  
Created BIND configuration and zone files and appended DNS commands to the relevant startup files; no images, links, IP addresses, or routes were changed.  
Static inspection covered the root, example.com and research.lab.net delegations. `named-checkzone` and `named-checkconf` were unavailable, and runtime resolution remains untested.
